==About==

Crafting {{i|Soulcake}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make {{i|Soulcake Dough}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Soulcake. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
